name: Indian Spiced Lentil Soup with Sweet Potato, Spinach & Pita

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
0.68 kg sweet potato
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice the onions. Peel and mince the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, rinse the lentils in a colander or strainer.
Add ginger and spices to the pot; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp curry powder
1 tbsp coriander
1 ½ tsp cumin

instructions.primary_message: Add the lentils, broth, water, salt and pepper to the pot; bring the mixture to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
1420 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and small dice the sweet potatoes; add to the pot.
Trim and discard the leaves and thick stem of the cauliflower heads and cut into small, bite-sized pieces; add to the pot.
Stir to combine the soup, then cover and reduce the heat to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until lentils and vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Uncover the soup and stir in the spinach. Cook until spinach is wilted and soup is heated through, about 4 more minutes.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and serve with pita on the side. Enjoy!
